data.one_liner: Provides a vsync ticker for AnimationController compatible with the provider package.
data.what_it_does: VsyncProvider bridges the provider ecosystem with AnimationControllers by supplying the required vsync ticker. This allows widgets to easily handle animations without managing TickerProviderStateMixin manually.
use_when: You are using the provider package for state management and need a vsync for AnimationControllers
You want to avoid using TickerProviderStateMixin in your StatefulWidgets
avoid_when: You are not using the provider package
you are using an alternative state management solution like Riverpod or Bloc
strengths: Simplifies animation controller creation with provider
Eliminates the need for TickerProviderStateMixin in many cases
weaknesses: Tied directly to the provider package ecosystem
